Kageaki"You cannot see?"
Chachamaru"Seeing is why apun is getting frightened."
Kageaki"Testing whether you are useful. We begin now."
Chachamaru"Arre, warning toh do! There is a procedure before a test!"
Chachamaru"Mental preparation, bhai. The mind has to arrive first!"
Kageaki"Call it quickly."
Chachamaru"The test has STARTED. How to prepare now!?"
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"Don't give me the silent treatment! At least say why apun's peaceful night has become a surprise examination!"
Kageaki"An explanation?"

en.html:
Kageaki"There is no reason to keep you alive."
Chachamaru"N-no! Apun will help. Everything possible. Everything."
Chachamaru"That IS my purpose, bhai!"
Kageaki"I know. As long as you don't get the order of things backward."
Kageaki"For Hikaru alone I act. Horigoe Kubo, I help you only insofar as it benefits her."
Chachamaru"Yes..."
Kageaki"Adjutant. What a nuisance you have arranged."
Kageaki"Every little thing, I must face those generals now? Not men with one or two peculiarities. Peculiarities tied together and issued a rank."
Chachamaru"Hahaha, true that."
Kageaki"You are their leading specimen."
Chachamaru"Ouch..."
Kageaki"Just imagining it is tiring. Children who refuse to attend school, now I understand them."
Chachamaru"B-but listen. Appointing you without asking, sorry for that."
Chachamaru"Still, a proper position makes things easier. Apun can leave Fudaraku in your hands and work outside, no?"
Kageaki"Hmph."
Chachamaru"So... forgiveness, perhaps? Thoda sa? Apun would be very happy..."

ja.html:
景明「お前を生かしておく必要もない」
茶々丸「の、のーっ！ 　それやります！　死力を尽くして全力で！」
茶々丸「ていうかそれがあての目的っす!!」
景明「わかっている。 　お前が事の順序を履き違えていなければ、 それでいい」
景明「俺は光のためにしか動かん。 　堀越公方、お前に手を貸すのは、それが光 の身に益する限りにおいてだ」
茶々丸「ハイ……」
景明「副官か。 　面倒な事を」
景明「何かにつけ、さっきのあの連中・・・・と面を突き 合わせなくてはならんわけか。 　どいつもこいつも、一癖二癖どころか…… むしろ癖しかないような将軍ども」
茶々丸「あはは、ほんとだねー」
景明「お前が筆頭だ」
茶々丸「あうち……」
景明「想像するだに疲れる。 　登校拒否児の心情がわかるな」
茶々丸「で、でもでも。 　勝手にやっちゃったのはごめんなさいなの ですが」
茶々丸「やっぱりそれなりの立場にいてくれた方が、 色々やりやすいと思いますのです。 　あてとしても、お兄さんに普陀楽を任せて 外で動けるようになるし……」
景明「ふん」
茶々丸「というわけなんで……あの…… 　許していただけると、嬉しいなー、なんて 思ったりとか……」

en.html:
Kageaki"...Very well. The appointment is made; that cannot be undone."
Kageaki"I shall get whatever use I can from this adjutant's position."
Chachamaru"Waah! This positive-thinking bhai, apun likes very much!"
Chachamaru"I'll make up for the trouble, pakka!"
Kageaki"Then be quiet and attend to the papers."
Chachamaru"Yes!"
Chachamaru"............"
Chachamaru"...?"
Chachamaru"Wait. Why is the mountain of work still there?"
Kageaki"I said attend to it."
Chachamaru"Bhai, one small celebration first? Tea? A pause in the national emergency?"
Kageaki"No."
Chachamaru"Uff... then at least tell me."
Chachamaru"You do like apun a little, no?"
Kageaki"Not particularly."
Chachamaru"What a dry-hearted stone you are!"
Chachamaru"Only the work you like? Filing papers is your entire happiness?"
Kageaki"Not particularly. That either."
Chachamaru"Everything rejected! Full negative man!"
Chachamaru"Then WHY this midnight punishment?"
Kageaki"To make your position clear."
Chachamaru"What position?"
Kageaki"You are my means of saving Hikaru. Keep that in mind."
Chachamaru"..."
